# Search and product analytics -- stub

This dashboard is a **stub**, not a working implementation. It is registered here (and provisioned by Grafana) so the file exists at the path grafana-dashboards.md's provisioning section names, but its panels have not been built.

The real specification -- audience, refresh interval, decision supported, and every panel's query -- is #5 of [docs/architecture/grafana-dashboards.md](../grafana-dashboards.md#5-search-and-product-analytics). See infrastructure/observability/grafana/dashboards/README.md for which dashboards are real and which are stubs.
